QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Trade] Ten Trades for Luna
QuestInfo.0: You're ready to start trading. Talk to the #p9390220# in Commerci Trade Center to set sail.
QuestInfo.1: You're supposed to be able to make a lot of money off of trade with the Luna region. Trade with Dolce 5 times so that they'll trust you.
QuestInfo.2: You traded with Dolce 5 times, and now you can trade with Luna!

0.1: So, you want to get rich quick? Well, our guild can help you with that.
0.2: Trade with Dolce 5 times to proceed to Luna, the next trade area. You will be able to get more Gold and EXP there.

yes.0: #h0#, you should be able to reach the next trade area before anyone else.

default.0: #h0#, you still have not completed the 5 trades in the Dolce region. Go to the trade UI and mouse over an area to see how many trades you have completed.
